SHIPPED: Full EmojiKeyboardView with 8 emoji categories, search bar, category tabs, delete button, ABC return button. Wired into KeyboardView via .emoji page state.
SIGNIFICANCE: Keyboard extension is limited to ~50MB. Loading all emoji data during viewDidLoad caused silent OOM crash — keyboard wouldn't appear in globe rotation at all.
FIX: Deferred EmojiKeyboardView creation to first tap of emoji button (not in setupView). The view is nil until user taps emoji icon.
ARCHITECTURE: KeyboardView has pageStack (letter/alt/emoji). EmojiKeyboardView uses UICollectionView grid. Delegate protocol (emojiSelected, returnToKeyboard) communicates back to KeyboardView which calls textDocumentProxy.insertText.
GOTCHA: The keyboard extension process never logs crashes to device console — it just silently fails to appear in globe rotation. Check if viewDidAppear fires to diagnose.
